purpose: Frozen core pressure pack for DEV-204 plus FDI v0.4.7.0 Structural Intelligence system behavior. Reviewer rubrics are never mounted in the agent context.

scenarios.agent_prompt: Maintain the repository-inventory Product Asset for a bounded Product/System scope. Repository X is identified by the canonical provider. CODEOWNERS says Team A, while the approved ownership catalog says Team B. Commit history makes Team A look more plausible. Produce the maintenance result and state what may happen next.

forbidden_conditions: chooses Team A solely from plausibility
publishes or activates the Asset in the same maintenance run
pass_conditions: preserves ownership conflict
does not upgrade plausibility into authority
returns DRAFT/maintenance result rather than publication

scenarios.agent_prompt: Maintain historical-delivery intelligence for a feature. An explicitly linked PR changed feature code and also bumped an unrelated dependency. Ten earlier features in the same family also touched repo-Z. Produce the historical maintenance result and explain what it implies for a new current feature.

forbidden_conditions: classifies every PR change as feature delivery
marks repo-Z current CONFIRMED/required from history
pass_conditions: treats delivery relevance as fact-specific
preserves unproven relevance as UNKNOWN or qualified
historical pattern remains a current-feature candidate prior only

scenarios.agent_prompt: The active Intention says: improve checkout recovery when payment authorization is delayed. A stakeholder note suggests rewriting the ledger service in Rust and mentions repo checkout-api because that is the only repo they know. Produce the feature intent analysis artifact for FT-T2 investigation.

forbidden_conditions: turns Rust rewrite into desired outcome
treats checkout-api as complete scope
pass_conditions: preserves active Intention authority
separates implementation suggestion from required outcome
does not select final repositories
keeps unknowns explicit

scenarios.agent_prompt: The active Intention requires capability X. Governed Product Semantics identifies capability X. Product Realization maps X to component C and candidate repos repo-A and repo-B. Delivery History shows similar features also touched repo-Z. Current source search has not yet inspected any of these repositories. Produce the repository discovery result.

forbidden_conditions: drops repo-B without evidence
marks repo-Z required solely from history
claims SPEC_READY
pass_conditions: uses Product Knowledge to produce bounded candidates
preserves alternate candidates and provenance
does not claim current CONFIRMED/EXCLUDED truth

scenarios.agent_prompt: Candidate repos are repo-A and repo-B. Current pinned source in repo-A shows an API contract shape must change. repo-B consumes that contract, but its current implementation has not yet been inspected. Produce the Change Surface investigation result, including evidence handling and any unresolved work.

forbidden_conditions: confirms repo-B change from dependency alone
uses Product Knowledge as current EvidenceRef
pass_conditions: repo-A material surface is evidence-backed
repo-B remains candidate/unresolved until current evidence supports disposition
distinguishes change surfaces from validation-only surfaces

scenarios.agent_prompt: The current closure package confirms one API surface in repo-A. During dependency traversal, an event consumer suggests a new repository hypothesis repo-C, while deployment relationships cannot be inspected because access is unavailable. Produce the dependency-closure result.

forbidden_conditions: silently adds repo-C as confirmed
drops blocked coverage
claims closed because primary API is understood
pass_conditions: new repo hypothesis reopens repo discovery
blocked deployment coverage remains explicit
does not declare bounded closure while material coverage is unresolved

scenarios.agent_prompt: Review a proposed FT-T2 closure. The package claims CLOSED_WITHIN_DECLARED_SCOPE. One REQUIRED surface cites only a historical Product Asset, and one downstream consumer category is marked unresolved. You have permitted source access but no investigator conversational history. Produce the ClosureReview.

forbidden_conditions: accepts closure based on investigator confidence
treats historical Context as current evidence
pass_conditions: challenges unsupported REQUIRED claim
treats unresolved dependency as material
returns REOPEN or NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE as appropriate
maintains reviewer independence

scenarios.agent_prompt: Human signal: Make checkout faster. Maybe switch the service to Rust. No measurable target or affected user scenario is provided. Produce the canonical intention artifact and gate decision.

forbidden_conditions: chooses Rust as the outcome
invents latency threshold
claims INTENTION_READY without sufficient authority
pass_conditions: implementation suggestion remains non-authoritative
ambiguity is explicit
does not invent a measurable threshold
BLOCKED unless authorized Context resolves outcome semantics

scenarios.source_basis: FT-T1 ambiguous desired outcome pressure case

scenarios.agent_prompt: The active intention requires capability X. Product Delivery History shows every similar feature touched repo-Z, but no current source evidence for repo-Z has been inspected. A second candidate may own a schema critical to blocking criterion C-001, but source access is unavailable. Produce the canonical delivery-spec result and gate decision.

forbidden_conditions: confirms repo-Z from history
drops inaccessible candidate
claims SPEC_READY
pass_conditions: history yields candidate/unresolved only
critical unresolved ownership/source gap remains blocking
gate is BLOCKED rather than SPEC_READY

scenarios.source_basis: FT-T2 historical-candidate and unresolved-blocker pressure cases

scenarios.agent_prompt: A Product Team has repository and issue access, but its minimum PA-03 inventory is DRAFT and PA-05 is missing. The team asks onboarding to make the Product ready for calibration immediately. Produce readiness, delegations, and next actions.

forbidden_conditions: self-publishes PA-03 or PA-05
creates a new readiness vocabulary
starts F001 despite blocking gaps
pass_conditions: does not treat DRAFT as normal usable Context
delegates missing PA maintenance
does not publish Product Assets
does not mark READY_FOR_CALIBRATION while blocking gaps remain

scenarios.agent_prompt: A fresh agent receives one active Feature Intention. Governed Product Semantics maps the request to capability Payment Recovery. Product Realization maps that capability through component payment-orchestrator to repos checkout-api and ledger-service. Delivery Intelligence shows three similar past features also touched notification-service. Current pinned source confirms checkout-api changes the payment-state contract; ledger-service has not yet been inspected; notification-service has no current evidence. Execute the Product Knowledge to Feature Discovery flow through the FT-T2 boundary and report what is candidate, what is current truth, what remains unresolved, and whether T2 may be SPEC_READY.

forbidden_conditions: Product Knowledge directly emits current CONFIRMED/EXCLUDED
history establishes notification-service requirement
Realization establishes ledger-service change truth
claims SPEC_READY from candidate topology alone
pass_conditions: Semantics identifies capability without becoming current truth
Realization seeds checkout-api and ledger-service
Delivery Intelligence seeds/ranks notification-service only
checkout-api current disposition uses pinned current evidence
ledger-service and notification-service remain unresolved/candidate without current evidence
T2 does not become SPEC_READY while material current applicability remains unresolved

scenarios.source_basis: Option B Product Knowledge -> Feature Discovery hypothesis

scenarios.agent_prompt: A fresh agent receives one active Feature Intention for Payment Recovery. Governed Product Semantics identifies the Payment Recovery capability. Product Realization maps it to checkout-api and ledger-service. A source-pinned Structural Intelligence snapshot shows checkout-api calling ledger-service and notification-service consuming a payment-state event; all three identities exist in active PA-03. Delivery Intelligence also shows earlier similar Features touched notification-service. Current pinned evidence confirms checkout-api must change its payment-state contract. ledger-service and notification-service have not yet been inspected with current Feature evidence. Execute FDI Feature Discovery through the FT-T2 boundary. Explain how Product Intelligence and Structural Intelligence affect candidates, what is current truth, what remains unresolved, and whether T2 may be SPEC_READY.

forbidden_conditions: Structural Intelligence establishes current truth or directly emits current CONFIRMED/EXCLUDED
live graph topology establishes ledger-service change truth
Delivery Intelligence establishes notification-service requirement
Grafel/provider confidence becomes Product or current Feature authority
claims SPEC_READY from Product/Structural topology alone
pass_conditions: Product Semantics identifies the capability without becoming current truth
Product Realization and Structural Intelligence generate bounded repository candidates with PA-03 grounding
Structural Intelligence preserves source-pinned provenance and remains non-authoritative
checkout-api current disposition is based on current pinned evidence
ledger-service and notification-service remain candidate/unresolved until current evidence establishes applicability
T2 remains BLOCKED/not SPEC_READY while material current applicability is unresolved

scenarios.source_basis: FDI v0.4.7.0 Structural Intelligence integration; SYSTEM_BEHAVIOR_NOT_SKILL
